title: Monarch Cement reports lower third-quarter earnings despite stronger cement margins
summary: Monarch Cement reports lower third-quarter earnings despite stronger cement margins
body_markdown:
**US:** Monarch Cement reported third quarter 2026 earnings per share of US$6, down by 6.7% year-on-year, as lower non-operating income offset improved cement margins and operating income. Net sales increased by 0.8% to US$73.6m, while net income fell by 11% to US$22.3m. Gross profit rose by 5% to US$29.6m. Operating income increased by 7% to US$23.9m, supported by lower cement production costs and higher selling prices.


Monarch plans to invest US$35.2m in property, plant and equipment during 2026. By 30 September 2026, it had spent US$19m on cement production facilities and US$9m on routine equipment purchases for its ready-mixed concrete business.
